build_model: build an AlphaZero model with policy and value heads using flax nnx for games like connect four
create_alpha_zero_model: create an AlphaZero neural network model with mlp, conv2d, or resnet torso and shared policy and value heads
run_inference: run inference on the AlphaZero model to get policy logits and value predictions for a given observation
update_model: update the AlphaZero model with a training batch containing observations, legals mask, policy targets, and value targets
save_checkpoint: save a checkpoint of the AlphaZero model state including parameters, batch stats, and optimizer state
